gameDescriptionHtml:
Diatomic is Complete with over 30+ Levels of face paced action, gun juggling, epic boss fights, Agility Challenges and much more! Level up, unlock new abilities and customize your power ups to try and conquer this brutally difficult arena shooter where the only way to survive is to keep moving!

Kill – Steal weapon – kill again!

Health and weaponry can all be gained from killing enemies as you charge through this arena shooter by sprinting, parkouring off walls or by flying through the air with your grappling hook!

Game Features

  • Fast Paced Action
  • Gun Juggling
  • Parkour
  • Grapple Swinging
  • 30+ Levels
  • 70+ Weapons
  • 20+ Enemy Types
  • Leveling up with Power ups
  • Unlock-able new abilities
  • Boss Fights!
  • Agility challenges
  • Destructible Environments
